title: Dedup merge proposals must be validated before any merge state or issue metadata changes
answers: partial merge applied when a dedup group is invalid
invalid merge overwrote a valid merged issue
overlapping dedup groups merge incorrectly in discovery
transitive dedup merge with bad group
body:
Invariant: _dedup_issues must finish validating a proposed group before it writes merge state (group_by_root, union-find roots) or issue name, description, root_cause, or example_indices. A group that fails validation must not partially mutate anything.
Enforced at: mlflow/genai/discovery/pipeline.py:_dedup_issues, in the validation check that runs before root = min(group.indices) and the group_by_root assignment.
What breaks if skipped: an invalid group that overlaps a valid one can overwrite the valid merge's metadata or leave an issue changed by a rejected proposal. Valid overlapping groups must still merge transitively.
Tests: tests/genai/discovery/test_pipeline.py:test_dedup_issues_invalid_group_cannot_overwrite_valid_merge covers both orderings; new cases should compare full model_dump() snapshots taken before the call.
applies: Applies to any change to how _dedup_issues accepts, rejects, or applies merge groups.
says: Rejected duplicate issue merges in discovery are still modifying issue details and descriptions.
Overlapping duplicate groups overwrite previously merged issue metadata in the discovery view.
An invalid issue merge proposal partially changed the root cause and example list.
Ensure discovery issue deduplication validates merge candidates before mutating any issue fields.
search: Deduplication issue merge proposals must be fully validated before writing merge state or mutating issue metadata. In mlflow/genai/discovery/pipeline.py:_dedup_issues, validation must finish before assigning group_by_root, union-find roots, name, description, root_cause, or example_indices to prevent invalid groups from corrupting valid overlapping merges. This invariant applies to any change in how _dedup_issues handles merge groups, with regression coverage in tests/genai/discovery/test_pipeline.py:test_dedup_issues_invalid_group_cannot_overwrite_valid_merge requiring model_dump() snapshot comparisons.
